thin: City of Mesa lists only four behavioral health names and 211 returned one Mesa provider; the only list naming many East Valley clinics is a 2021 Mercy Care flier. Valleywise Behavioral Health Center Mesa and the East Valley urgent psychiatric centre (CPEC) were on no list read. Match corrections by eye: Crisis Text Line (to Teen Lifeline), Mental Health Guild (0.83 to MHA Arizona), NAZCARE (0.67 to Solari warm line) and Center for Health and Recovery (1.0 to SRPMIC) set to none; Bayless (0.6 to Denova Dobson) was kept because Bayless is now Denova at the same address.
